content: Ani kavaꞌmo hiyo, huno huꞌniya gemae

Nahau nayamopafiꞌmo nahauꞌniya konagaꞌnimogitapae, lapakaefeꞌmo lusi kava huno neꞌnahaiye. Lapakaefeꞌmo namogaga neꞌauvanageno Gotiꞌa lapakaetetiꞌmo ala nagiꞌnimo namigiye. Inagi Ala kava nepiꞌmo lokiya vaitapa he tita maiyo.
Yuvotigaꞌe Sitakigaꞌefeꞌmo lanahao ke nehovanagi, lanakaemo Ala kava nepiꞌmo maiꞌnetanaeꞌmo magoke lanaipa lanakesamo alitana maiꞌao.

Goti aliꞌyaꞌamo nagaeꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeka neꞌalina veꞌnimogae, Kagaefeꞌmo kahao ke nehovanagi, ani lole atalaꞌmo nagaeꞌeꞌmo alagepa faigoko gelefeꞌmo magokepi lokaeꞌana aliꞌyaꞌmo aliꞌnaꞌa atalaꞌmo alagepa huka hana mao. Anakaegi Kilemeniꞌagi muki vayaꞌmo nagaeꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeta aliꞌyaꞌmo neꞌaluna vayanagi apakiꞌapimo Gotiꞌa maige maige huꞌa maisaya vayaꞌai apakiꞌapimo avoꞌmo kae maleꞌniya mukufiꞌmo avoꞌmo kae maleꞌniye.
Ala kava nefeꞌmo muki afinaꞌmo lapamogaga aiyo. Halate, lapamogaga aiyo, huꞌna nehuve.
Yuna lapaipa kavaꞌmo alitapa apave ligeꞌapao lapakeyo, Ala kava neꞌmo ago eminesiya afinaꞌmo alagi hogo nehiyanagi.

Mago kavafeꞌmo lapausoli osuta muki kavatefeꞌmo nunumu hutapa afi neketapaeꞌmo hao ke nehetapa lapauꞌnisiya yafeꞌmo Gotifeꞌmo ge huta afi gegenoꞌao lapaipamo alino falu huno lapategaiye. Haiya kava huno laipamo alino falu huno nelatefi oꞌageꞌnonaꞌmonanafa afaꞌa alino falu huno lapatesiya kavaꞌmoꞌa Kalaisi Yesupiꞌmo maiꞌnayanageno lapaipa lapakesaleꞌmo afaꞌa yagaino lapategaiye.

Konagaꞌnimogitapae, geꞌnimo huꞌna hano hugefeꞌmo huꞌnaeꞌmo, lapakaemo muki alagepa kavaꞌe ala apakiꞌapimo neꞌapamiya kavaꞌefeꞌmo lapakesa afifi hutapa maiyo. Lama ge kavanagi ani kavatefeꞌmo agiꞌaleꞌmo aliꞌa asaga huꞌa neꞌataya kavanagi fatago kavanagi oꞌaniꞌya yaꞌmo ohaneꞌniya kavanagi kanale kavanagi ala agiꞌamo haneꞌniya kavanagi hutapa lapakesa afifi hutapa maiyo.

Nagaemo aliꞌna lapaya maleꞌnogetapa alita lapaipafiꞌmo maleꞌnaya gemo akame hiyo. Nava gemo afiteta nehuva kavaꞌmo ago nageꞌnayanagi nakame higenoꞌao Gotiꞌa laipamo alino falu nehiya kavaꞌmo aepa vekamoꞌa lapakaeꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeno maino.
Poloꞌa fiku ha maeꞌa amiꞌnaya yaꞌmo alitenoꞌaeꞌmo hapao ke heꞌniya gemae

Yatala afinaꞌmo utegetapa halate nagaefeꞌmo lusi kava hutapa lapakesamo neꞌafitapa mago yaꞌmo fiku naha maeta namiꞌnageꞌnaeꞌmo Ala kava nepiꞌmo lusi kava huꞌna namogaga aiꞌnove. Muki afinaꞌmo nagaefeꞌmo lapakesamo neꞌafiyaꞌmonanafa alita nave lisaya kaꞌmo ohaneꞌniye.
Mago yafeꞌmo kafu huꞌneꞌnaeꞌmo mani gemo nehufiye. Haꞌao, Kalaisiꞌa alino naya maleꞌnigeꞌna haiya kava huꞌna neꞌmaufigeꞌna vayaꞌmogi naha maesayafeꞌmo nagesamo oꞌafiꞌna afaꞌa maiꞌnove.

Kafu hu afinaꞌe magoꞌe yaꞌmo neꞌaluva afinaꞌeꞌmo afaꞌa maisuvafeꞌmo afiteꞌna ageꞌnove. Muki afinaꞌmo uꞌneꞌna huꞌna neꞌmauvategamo alu kava alu kavaꞌmo afole neꞌaigeꞌnaeꞌmo afaꞌa maiꞌnove. Alino naya maleꞌnigeꞌnaeꞌmo naga netefi namu nepaefi kafu nehufi alopa yaꞌmo aliꞌnofi huꞌna afaꞌa maisuvafeꞌmo ago afiteꞌna ageꞌnove.
Nagaemo Kalaisipiꞌmo maiꞌneꞌnaeꞌmo lokiya vaino neꞌnateya himamuꞌaletiꞌmo muki kavaꞌamo afaꞌa huguve.
Ani gemo nehuvaꞌmonanafa kanamo neꞌaluva kavatefeꞌmo alagepa kava hutapa nagaeꞌeꞌmo afalu afalugana hutapa naha maeꞌnae.

Filipai vayaꞌmogitapamo ago afiꞌnayana nagaemo hogote afinaꞌmo alagepa faigoko gemo aeꞌna hakalo huꞌna lapa paiteꞌna Masetoniya kotegamo ataleꞌna uꞌnogeꞌapaeꞌmo muki siosiꞌale siosiꞌaleꞌmo maiꞌnaya vayaꞌmogimo namiteꞌa alisayafeꞌmo nagaeꞌeꞌmo afalu afalugana huꞌa lokaeꞌa aliꞌyaꞌmo oꞌaliꞌnagetapa lapakaekeꞌmo nagaeꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeta aliꞌyaꞌmo aliꞌnae.
Lapataleꞌna uꞌna Tesalonaika taonifiꞌmo maiꞌnogetapaeꞌmo magoꞌe yaꞌmo muki afinaꞌae afinaꞌaeꞌmo naha maetapa namiꞌnae.
Nagaemo mago yaꞌmo fiku alisuvafeꞌmo nagesamo noꞌafufa lapakaekeꞌmo akamelegati magoꞌe yaꞌmo alisayafekeꞌmo nagesamo neꞌafuve.

Inagi muki namiꞌnaya yaꞌmo aliꞌnogeno magoꞌe yaꞌnimo afaꞌa haneꞌniye. Epafalonaitasiꞌa fiku namiꞌnaya yaꞌmo alinineno namiꞌnigeꞌna haiꞌmo aliꞌnove. Alagepa atumo neꞌaiya ofalinimo haneꞌnigeno Gotiꞌa hauꞌnigeno amuse huno nelapate.
Gotiꞌnimoꞌa Kalaisi Yesutetiꞌmo asole yaꞌmo maleꞌniya yapatiꞌmo lapakaemo muki kafu huꞌnisaya yaꞌmo afa alino lapamigiye.
Afotimo Goti agiꞌaleꞌmo muki afinaꞌae afinaꞌaeꞌmo alita asaga hulita vigetao. He, lama ge.
Geꞌnimo alagi hano huꞌniya gemae
Lapakaemo muki vayaꞌmo Kalaisi Yesupiꞌmo apaote vayaꞌaifeꞌmo ge apamamaeyo. Nagaeꞌeꞌmo lokaeꞌa maiꞌnaya konagatimogiꞌeꞌmo ge lapamamaeꞌnae.
Muki apaote vayaꞌmogi ge lapamamaeꞌnayaꞌmonanafa hogote gamani vekamo aliꞌyaꞌamo neꞌaliya vayaꞌmogiꞌeꞌmo magoꞌe huꞌa ge lapamamaeꞌnae.
Ala kava netimo Yesu Kalaisiꞌa mukiꞌamogitapamo fiku lapa maeno lapamino. He, lama ge.
